name: object_store_encryption
description: Server-side encryption applied to artifact objects the traust SDKs write.

definitions.bucket-default: No encryption header is sent; the bucket's default encryption policy applies.
definitions.sse-s3: Server-side encryption with keys managed by the object store (SSE-S3).
definitions.sse-kms: Server-side encryption with a customer-managed KMS key (SSE-KMS); requires kms_key_id.

standard.name: Amazon S3 server-side encryption
standard.note: bucket-default names the absence of a per-object header; S3-compatible stores implement the same SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS headers.
